reviews.author: karishma
reviews.title: My Door lock installation done after 4 days of delivery
reviews.body: The door lock itself is good, does the job. To unlock the door when away from home you need to buy Wifi gateway separately. No proper contact details for Mygate brand, no communication was done from the brand after delivery, needed to go to mygate app, manually request for installation, that too only limited slots were available. The brand number provided by Amazon is unresponsive. Installation was done successfully after 4 days of delivery, KP Chary was prompt and did wonderful job. Yet to see how post installation service is going to be..!!
